name: mad-coo-trusted-beta
description: MAD COO Staging Preview thin connector with approval-gated Gmail-assisted commercial-email review.

interface.shortDescription: Private beta access to the licensed MAD COO staging service.
interface.longDescription: Connects every limited-beta tester to the same licensed MAD COO staging service. Tenant access is resolved from the signed-in account. Commercial-email requests can use the user's separately connected Gmail app for scoped read-only context before MAD COO prepares an approval-labelled chat draft or hold.
